name: Market Research Recommendations
purpose: Planning reference for the Guided Book Builder. This is not sales or profit data; Amazon does not publicly provide unit sales or profit by niche.

recommended_directions.direction: Large-print themed collections for adults and seniors
recommended_directions.why: The visible bestseller list includes many large-print adult and senior formats and substantial puzzle-count collections.
Mindfulness and acts-of-kindness themed word searches appear in the visible bestseller signals.
Nostalgic television and decade-oriented activity titles appear in the visible bestseller signals.
Garden, four-seasons and holiday themed word-search titles appear in current marketplace results.
A national-parks collection is currently visible in marketplace results; focused series also create clear follow-up volumes.

guardrails: Validate each title, subtitle and cover claim before publishing.
Use original generic vocabulary for new books; do not market unofficial franchise, celebrity or trademark collections without permission.
Treat price and competition as a live decision to check again before publishing.
